thesis: The site is the visit note: every section is one numbered finding on the paper the homeowner receives, with its status chip, a photo slot and a plain sentence; scrolling turns the page.

signature.name: Numbered Findings
signature.summary: A .finding primitive with mono F-NN number, tri-color status chip (OK/WATCH/FIX), form-line rule and optional camera-scope photo circle. Appears in hero (Finding 00), services (each service is a finding), proof (signed notes), prices (sample rows), contact (Finding 12 sign-off) and footer (printer line). Hook: data-sw-signature='finding-note'.

motion.intro: Note slides up 40px with opacity; status chips stamp on in 80ms stagger. Content readable before via .sw-motion gate.
stories: Pinned camera-scope wipe on desktop: circular clip-path descends across flue photo during sweep finding, height calc(3*55svh+100svh), reverses on scroll-up.
Finding numbers count up via data-count; status chip fades in after number settles.
motion.hover: Hairline under finding headers grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, (hover:hover) only.
